## Meeting Purpose

[To realign on team values, define roles, and establish a new workflow.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=16.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Roles Defined:** Adrian is now Product Owner (final decision-maker), Enes leads dev, Larissa leads lead generation, and E F handles marketing ops (SEO, ads).](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=1888.0)
  - [**New Workflow:** Bi-weekly sprint meetings will review progress and create placeholder tickets. Tickets will then be refined offline, ensuring clear scope before development.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4297.0)
  - [**Top Priority: Lead Generation:** The primary goal is acquiring new users. All marketing efforts will focus on this, with YouTube as the initial channel.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=3101.0)
  - [**Landing Page Rework:** The current AI-generated copy will be rewritten to be more authentic. A/B testing will be used to validate changes against SEO performance.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4800.0)

## Topics

### Problem: Inefficient Workflow & Unclear Priorities

  - [The team's unstructured process led to wasted time, unclear priorities, and destructive feedback.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=218.0)
  - [A lack of a single Product Owner (PO) created decision-making deadlocks, slowing progress.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=1663.0)
  - [Past research-heavy projects failed due to a lack of real-world user feedback.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=1020.0)

### Solution: New Team Structure & Values

  - [**Core Value:** Customer-first. All decisions must provide clear customer value.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=442.0)
  - [**Decision-Making:** Adrian is the Product Owner, providing a final tie-breaking vote to resolve deadlocks.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4688.0)
  - [**Communication:**](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=84.0)
      - [**Constructive Feedback:** Focus on solutions, not just problems.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=218.0)
      - [**Transparency:** Use the shared Google Group for all customer/partner emails to ensure team-wide context.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=5392.0)
      - [**Accountability:** Communicate blockers early to allow for task reassignment.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=3941.0)

### Solution: New Workflow & Sprint Process

  - [**Meeting Cadence:** Bi-weekly sprint meetings.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=3844.0)
  - [**Meeting Agenda:**](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4297.0)
    1.  [Review previous sprint's progress.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4297.0)
    2.  [Discuss new priorities from the PO's backlog and Larissa's feedback doc.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4297.0)
    3.  [Create placeholder tickets for the next sprint.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4493.0)
  - [**Ticket Refinement:**](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4493.0)
      - [Placeholder tickets are refined offline by the responsible team members.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4493.0)
      - [Fathom recordings of meeting discussions provide context for ticket details.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4571.0)
      - [This ensures clear scope and prevents endless iteration.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=1346.0)

### Focus: Marketing & Lead Generation

  - [**Top Priority:** Lead generation. The product is working; the main need is more users.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=3101.0)
  - [**Channel Strategy:** Focus on one channel at a time to maximize impact.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=3325.0)
      - [**Initial Channel:** YouTube, as it is the primary information source for traders (65%).](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=3277.0)
      - [**Future Channels:** Reddit and X.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=3277.0)
  - [**Role Breakdown:**](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=2195.0)
      - [**Larissa:** Lead generation (B2B outreach, podcasts, YouTube collaborations).](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=3215.0)
      - [**E F:** Marketing ops (SEO, Google Ads, video editing, social media).](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=2450.0)
  - [**Analytics:** Improve PostHog tracking to measure marketing effectiveness.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=2704.0)

### Focus: Product Development

  - [**Landing Page Rework:** The current AI-generated copy is not authentic.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4800.0)
      - [**Action:** Rewrite the main page and create sub-pages (e.g., vs. Excel) for SEO.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4800.0)
      - [**Validation:** A/B test new copy against the current version to measure conversion impact.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=4937.0)
  - [**Bug Fixes:** High-priority bugs (e.g., Iron Condor validation) will be fixed immediately to maintain partner trust.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=5132.0)
  - [**Future Features:**](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=5883.0)
      - [**Trade Management:** Fix the timeline movement bug.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=5356.0)
      - [**Analytics:** Implement proper PostHog events.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=2704.0)
      - [**Wheel of Options:** A frequently requested feature, but its priority must be weighed against other tasks in the sprint planning.](https://fathom.video/share/YtqyQsta6hAceKQSetvVmZ6gTdroXkTs?tab=summary&timestamp=5883.0)
